newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW UPGRADES BOOTS TO BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW UPGRADES BOOTS TO BUY.

text.p: BZW put Boots Plc stock on its "buy" list on Thursday, dealers said.
The brokerage upgraded the stock after the UK retailer on Wednesday announced plans to launch a customer loyalty card.
While the launch is likely to pressure profits in the near-term, the card should begin to buoy earnings in the next two to three years, dealers said.
BZW reduced its current year profit forecasts by five million stg, but raised its 1998 estimate by ten million stg, they said.
At 0929 GMT, the shares were up 6p to 792, adding to Wednesday's 15p rise. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
